universities.name: University of Split School of Medicine
universities.summary: University of Split School of Medicine delivers Medical Studies in English as a six-year, 360-ECTS integrated programme leading to the Doctor of Medicine qualification. The route combines foundational science, clinical skills and supervised clinical learning in Split, with a published 2026/27 fee and two application categories for international applicants.
universities.campusLifestyle: Medical Studies in English is delivered at the School of Medicine in Split. The School's new-student information links international students with the Medical Studies in English office, counselling and student-support resources while the arrival guide explains local administrative steps and private-housing search routes.
universities.cityProfile: Split is the programme's Croatian study location. The School directs foreign students to private accommodation rather than presenting School-provided housing; its published guide advises a full-stay rental contract because of the local tourist season. No verified standard living-cost figure is included in this package.
universities.practicalExposure: The official curriculum sets out 5,500 hours of direct teaching across six years. It moves from natural and basic medical sciences into clinical sciences, clinical skills and a graduate thesis. Clinical Propedeutics follows successful completion of Year 2 and introduces direct patient work; later clinical subjects and rotations develop supervised experience through the final year, which concludes with aggregate knowledge and skills examinations.
universities.hostelOverview: The School's published new-student guide directs foreign students to private accommodation and provides housing-search resources. It does not offer a School-operated housing guarantee or a current standard room price for this programme, so accommodation costs and availability are not included in the programme fee.
universities.dietarySupport: No current School-operated meal plan or programme-specific food-cost schedule was verified. This package therefore does not present food costs as part of tuition or a fixed student budget.
universities.safetyOverview: No School-published campus-safety statistics were identified for this package. The arrival material focuses instead on legal stay, health cover, housing contracts and access to the School's support resources.
universities.studentSupport: The School publishes information on counselling, library access, an international student association, a student support group and the Medical Studies in English office. Its arrival guide covers OIB registration, temporary stay, health cover, visa orientation and housing search, while personal immigration outcomes remain determined by the relevant authority.

faq.question: How long is Medical Studies in English at Split?
faq.answer: It is a six-year integrated programme leading to the Doctor of Medicine qualification, with 360 ECTS.

faq.question: What is the published tuition for the English programme?
faq.answer: The verified 2026/27 call lists EUR 12,000 annual tuition plus a EUR 200 non-refundable application fee. It does not publish a complete living-cost budget.

faq.question: When is first-year tuition due after acceptance?
faq.answer: The 2026/27 call requires the first-year tuition to be paid in full within one week of the electronic acceptance letter. It states that tuition is non-refundable.

faq.question: What school background is required?
faq.answer: The verified call requires completed secondary education and final exams, with at least 12 years of prior education. It also specifies English-language evidence unless an exemption applies.

faq.question: Why are there School and central-admission steps?
faq.answer: The School's process requires direct submission and Croatia's Central Admission Office route, which includes record verification and, where relevant, recognition of foreign secondary education.

faq.question: Are there different Medical Studies in English categories?
faq.answer: The 2026/27 call offered an all-Split category and a category with the first three years in Split followed by three years at Sana Kliniken in Coburg, Germany. The chosen category could not later be changed.

faq.question: When does direct patient work begin?
faq.answer: Clinical Propedeutics follows successful completion of Year 2. The official curriculum describes subsequent clinical subjects and rotations as progressively developing supervised clinical experience.

faq.question: Does the degree guarantee medical registration abroad?
faq.answer: No. The curriculum follows Croatia's regulated-professions framework, but professional registration, licensing examinations, language requirements, immigration and residency rules are determined by the destination authority.

faq.question: Is School-provided accommodation included?
faq.answer: No. The new-student guide directs foreign students to private accommodation and does not state a School-provided housing guarantee or a fixed programme accommodation cost.

faq.question: Are English-MD scholarships published?
faq.answer: No programme-specific tuition scholarship or fee waiver was identified in the verified 2026/27 English-MD call. Funding discussions should use a current official award notice with its terms.

fee.notes: The 2026/27 call publishes EUR 12,000 annual tuition and a EUR 200 non-refundable application fee. It requires first-year tuition payment in full within one week of the electronic acceptance letter and says tuition is non-refundable. EUR 72,000 is the annual tuition multiplied by six years, not a university-published all-in package; it excludes housing, health cover, immigration and living costs.

restrictions: The verified 2026/27 call required English evidence unless prior education was in English or English is the applicant's mother tongue

audienceEligibility.notes: The 2026/27 call used mutually exclusive all-Split and Split-to-Coburg categories.

admissionsContent.overview: Applicants submit the prescribed Medical Studies in English file to the School and complete Croatia's Central Admission Office route, including foreign-education recognition where applicable. The 2026/27 call used a document-led process and required payment after an electronic acceptance letter.

eligibility.intro: The verified 2026/27 call requires completed secondary education with final examinations and at least 12 years of prior education, together with English-language evidence unless a published exemption applies.
items: Completed secondary education and final examinations after at least 12 years of education
English-language evidence unless the call's exemption for English-medium schooling or mother tongue applies

Register through the Postani Student portal and begin foreign-education recognition where required
Send certified records by tracked post to the Central Admission Office when the process requires it
Select Medical Studies in English after document verification

admissionsContent.deadlinesNote: The 2026/27 call set 22 May 2026 for applicants whose secondary education ended before 31 December 2025 and 1 July 2026 for 2026 school leavers. Both dates have passed; do not market a future intake until a new official call is available.
visaConsiderations: The School's arrival guide covers OIB registration, temporary stay, health cover and visa orientation; the applicable route depends on citizenship and is determined by Croatian authorities.
